decision_payload.analysis:

   - Price Return: +0.17% (positive, bullish signal)
   - Net Demand: -0.18 (negative, bearish signal)
   → Mixed signals (no strong consensus in crowd behavior)
2. Composite Sentiment Estimate:

3. Decision Rule Application: Neutral sentiment → hold position
